policies.title: Standard returns
policies.rule: Unused, unworn items with original tags may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a refund to the original payment method.

policies.title: Final sale
policies.rule: Items marked Final Sale are not returnable or exchangeable unless they arrived damaged or incorrect.

policies.title: Size exchanges
policies.rule: Eligible items may be exchanged once for another size within 30 days of delivery. The requested size must be in stock.

policies.title: Damaged or incorrect item
policies.rule: Report a damaged, defective, or incorrect item within 14 days of delivery with an order number and clear photos. Send a replacement at no charge when stock exists; otherwise refund.

policies.title: Lost in transit
policies.rule: If tracking has had no movement for 7 calendar days after shipment, open a carrier trace. After 10 days without movement, replace or refund the order.

policies.title: Late delivery
policies.rule: A package still moving but later than its delivery estimate is not refundable for shipping. Share tracking and offer a one-time 10% goodwill code only when it is 5 or more days late.

policies.title: Order cancellation
policies.rule: Orders can be canceled only before fulfillment. Once fulfilled, use the return process after delivery.

policies.title: Price adjustments
policies.rule: One price adjustment is allowed within 7 days of purchase for a public sitewide promotion. Excludes clearance, final sale, bundles, and third-party promotions.

policies.title: Promo codes
policies.rule: Only one promotion code may be applied per order. Codes cannot be added after an order is placed, and cannot be combined with sale or final-sale items.

policies.title: Account security
policies.rule: Never disclose or change account, address, payment, or order details without verified access to the account. Send account-access issues to secure support.
